Kill Oberan's minions outside the [[Sardelac Sanitarium]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = necromancer
}}

===Objectives===
* [0...6]/6 [[Oberan's Minion]]s slain.
* Return to [[Kasha Blackblood]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* {{skill icon|Dark Pact}}
* {{skill icon|Mark of Pain}}

==Walkthrough==
You will find Oberan's Minions east of the Sardelac Sanitarium. To complete the quest, you must kill all of them. If your character is low level, try to lure some minions with a bow or long-range skill to avoid luring the nearby Grawl, too.

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;Kasha Blackblood
:''"I have a task that seems well suited to your skills. One who was once a respected member of [[The Order|our order]] has turned against Ascalon. [[Oberan the Reviled]] seeks to live up to his name by carving out his own kingdom of the dead here in the ruins of Ascalon. Oberan is cunning but has an uncontrollable temper and can be goaded into action. I'd like you to head east of here, find his minions, and slay them. I think 6 should be a sufficient number to raise Oberan's ire. Are you up to the task?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = It should be no problem.
| decline = Perhaps later.
| ask = Seek out and slay '''Oberan's minions''' to the east.
}}

===Reward Dialogue===
;Kasha Blackblood
:''"And you killed 6 of his minions, you say? Excellent. Oberan should be truly enraged! Your actions this day are certain to draw him out of hiding."''
